title: Gradient norm and sensitivity
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$, every function $f$ from the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to the signs, and every input $x$, the square of the Euclidean norm of the discrete gradient of the real-valued function associated to $f$ at $x$ equals the sensitivity of $f$ at $x$, namely the number of coordinates whose flip changes the value of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to the signs
$x$ is an input in that cube
